nodes.label: eslint.config.js
nodes.description: ESLint configuration enforcing TypeScript strict rules: no-any, no-floating-promises, no-console (must use logger), no-require-imports. Relaxes floating-promises and console rules for test files.

nodes.label: jest.config.ts
nodes.description: Jest configuration using ts-jest preset. Sets globalSetup for DB creation+migration, setupFilesAfterEnv for per-file DB/Redis lifecycle, and moduleNameMapper for @/ path alias.

nodes.label: app.ts
nodes.description: Express application factory. Mounts helmet, cors, json parser, requestLogger middleware, rate limiter (100 req/15min), and all routes under /api/v1. Registers errorMiddleware as final handler.

nodes.label: server.ts
nodes.description: Bootstrap entry point. Initializes AppDataSource (PostgreSQL), connects Redis, then starts Express app. Calls process.exit(1) on any bootstrap failure.

nodes.label: InitialSchema migration
nodes.description: Full database schema migration creating 26 tables and all enum types: users, refresh_tokens, password_reset_tokens, cafes, cafe_images, cafe_closures, cafe_announcements, staff_cafe_assignments, vehicles, vehicle_images, feature_flags, promotions, menu_items, bookings, promotion_usages, payment_components, payment_transactions, inspection_records, extension_proposals, disputes, fnb_orders, fnb_order_items, trust_score_logs, notification_logs, vehicle_maintenance_logs, reviews. Seeds 7 feature flags.

nodes.label: validate/index.ts
nodes.description: Central Zod validation schema registry. Exports LoginSchema, GoogleSchema, RefreshSchema, LogoutSchema. All request body schemas live here per convention.

nodes.label: types/index.ts
nodes.description: Central enum and type registry. Defines UserRole, AuthProvider, TrustScoreReason, CafeStatus, TrackType, AssetTier, VehicleStatus, BookingMode, BookingSource, BookingStatus, PaymentComponentType, PaymentComponentStatus, DiscountType, InspectionType, DisputeStatus, FnbOrderType, FnbOrderStatus, NotificationChannel, AppError class, AuthPayload interface, AuthRequest interface.

nodes.label: config/redis.ts
nodes.description: Exports ioredis client instance configured from env. Uses lazyConnect:true. Logs connection errors via logger.

nodes.label: config/logger.ts
nodes.description: Custom logger module. Provides structured logging with level filtering (debug/info/warn/error). Specialized methods: http, server, database, auth, debug, info, warn, error. Timestamps in Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh timezone.

nodes.label: config/database.ts
nodes.description: Exports AppDataSource (TypeORM DataSource) for PostgreSQL. synchronize=false, entities loaded from models/**/*.entity.{ts,js}, migrations from migrations/**/*.{ts,js}.

nodes.label: config/env.ts
nodes.description: Typed environment configuration object. Sections: db (PostgreSQL), jwt (access+refresh tokens), redis, cloudinary, google (OAuth clientId), platform (feePct=0.15, paymentWindowMinutes=30, slotLockTtlSeconds=1800).

nodes.label: middlewares/logger.middleware.ts
nodes.description: Express requestLogger middleware. Masks sensitive fields (password, token, refresh_token, id_token, access_token) in request body logs. Intercepts res.json to log HTTP method, path, status, duration. Logs 4xx+ responses as warnings.

nodes.label: middlewares/error.middleware.ts
nodes.description: Express error handler middleware. Handles ZodError (400 VALIDATION_ERROR), AppError (custom status), and unhandled errors (500 INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR). Must be registered last in app.

nodes.label: middlewares/auth.middleware.ts
nodes.description: JWT authentication and RBAC authorization middleware. authenticate() verifies Bearer token using env.jwt.secret and attaches AuthPayload to req.user. authorize(...roles) checks req.user.role against allowed roles.

nodes.label: models/user.entity.ts (User)
nodes.description: TypeORM User entity mapped to 'users' table. Fields: id (uuid), email, full_name, phone, password_hash, auth_provider (AuthProvider enum), role (UserRole enum), trust_score (numeric 5,2 default 100), is_active, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at (soft delete).

nodes.label: __tests__/global-setup.ts
nodes.description: Jest globalSetup function. Creates rcfeild_test database if not exists (connects to 'postgres' db first). Then initializes DataSource on rcfeild_test and runs all migrations. Runs once before all test suites.

nodes.label: __tests__/jest-setup.ts
nodes.description: Jest setupFilesAfterEnv. beforeAll: initializes AppDataSource if not ready. beforeEach: TRUNCATE all 23 tables with RESTART IDENTITY CASCADE to reset test state. afterAll: destroys AppDataSource and quits Redis.
